title: Performance review
summary: As the manager, tell a strong engineer about a real problem and agree a plan.
goal: Ravi understands the impact of missed code review deadlines and agrees a plan to fix it.
scenario: Ravi is a strong engineer, but he regularly misses code review deadlines and the team is frustrated. This is his review.

attendees.name: Ravi
likely_objections: Nobody told me this was a problem
I was busy shipping the migration everyone wanted
attendees.knows: Thinks his review will be about the migration he led. Does not know the team has complained.

hidden_concerns: Whether this is fair and specific
success: Ravi understands the gap and agrees a specific plan with a check in date.
tips: Name the issue in the first two minutes, with one or two specific examples.
Listen, then restate his view before you respond.
Agree one concrete change and when you'll check in.

key_facts.label: Strength
key_facts.value: Led the database migration on time

ask: Agree to review within one working day, with a check in in four weeks.
